title: Kindergarten Interactive Writing
description:
The purpose of interactive writing is working on spelling practices, phonics, phonemic awareness, and writing conventions by "interactively" composing the piece together while sharing the pen.  These kinder students knew the structures and routines from the very start of the school year and were able to use white boards successfully. 

It takes roughly 8-10 minutes out of your day and using the word study data from the class, I was able to strategically choose which students to call on based on their Words Their Way assessment and Dibels assessment.

title: Kindergarten Shared Reading Informational Text
description: Shared reading is a great way to continue to expose students to oral language development while building background knowledge and having fun, too!  These big books by Hamaray Publishing Company are the BEST for shared reading because of the beautiful photographs and the text size is perfect to work on meaning, structure, and visual cues.  To continue the work around this big book, take a look at my prior video on Interactive Writing.

description:
The video serves as a quick walkthrough guiding student candidates on how to check their marks and see if their name is on the selected candidates list for the Tamil Nadu Chief Minister's Talent Search Examination (TNCMTSE/TCMTSE) 2026.
Steps Outlined in the Video:
Search Portal: Open Google and search for the official "DGE" website (Directorate of Government Examinations, Tamil Nadu). Click on the first available official link.
Navigate to Results: Find and click on the "Results" section on the homepage portal.
Select Examination: Scroll down and locate the section designated for the "Tamil Nadu Chief Minister Talent Search Examination" and click on "View Result".
Login Credentials:
Input the individual Roll Number found on your examination hall ticket.
Input your Date of Birth using the specific mandatory format sequence: YYYY-MM-DD (Year-Month-Date separated by hyphens).
View & Print: Once logged in, your detailed results and qualification status will appear on screen. Candidates can save or print out the sheet for future verification.

title: Teaching a Lesson In Front of Student Parents | Behind the Scenes VLOG
description:
It’s time for our “Parent Peek” again! If you aren’t familiar with “Parent Peek,” it’s essentially an opportunity for families to come into the classroom and get a “peek” at what we are doing. In other words, I get to teach a lesson in front of my students and their families… that’s both nervewrecking and exciting at the same time! You may remember the fruit themed stations we did last year (and yes, I dressed up as a banana) but this year we are changing it up. My students are creating “Rube Goldberg Machines” that will ring a bell, turn on a light, or pop a balloon. In this vlog, I take you behind the scenes of this “Parent Peek” and show you how I communicated this event with families, how this connects with our science curriculum, all of the slides I used to teach the lesson, and how I organized the materials. I can’t wait for you to hear all about it!

title: Welcome Walk & Howdy | Everything You Wanted to Know About Our Back to School Traditions
description:
My school has 2 big traditions that we follow EVERY YEAR before the first day of school to welcome students and their families into our classrooms! First is Welcome Walk where we visit our students at their houses to let them know that we will be their teacher for the year and drop off some important papers and information they will need before the first day of school. Second is Howdy where our students come and visit school to see our classroom and drop off their school supplies so it’s ready for them on the first day of school. Pinecraft Park
1420 Gilbert Ave.
Sarasota, FL 34239

✅ Pinecraft Park has…
🌳 Lots of nice, shaded areas
🥁 One musical element
🪷 Calm, low-stim areas off to the side
🔧 Well-maintained equipment
🛝 Seperate play structures by age
♿️ One accessible parking spot
🪑Seating for caregivers close by
🚽 Accessible restroom close to the playground
🚼 Changing table (50lb weight limit)

❌ Pinecraft Park does NOT have…
👨‍🦼 Adaptive or harnessed swings
👨‍🦽‍➡️ Accessible ground-level play (due to mulch)
🦼 Ramps, structures are step-up/climb-only
🪧 Communication boards
🔒 Secure fencing (there is no gate)
🟫 Firm, even ground - all mulch
〰️ Smooth pathways

Mayer Accessibility Score: 8/16
50% Accessible
1/5 ⭐️

Accessibility matters because it lets all kids safely join in the fun. Inclusive parks create equal opportunities for play, exploration, and community. ♥️

Make sure you follow me to see what park I’ll be rating next!

title: When You're a SURVIVOR of the Unexpected💪🏽
description:
Watch this next! → https://youtube.com/shorts/dDyBQL09qx8 
Subscribe for more! https://www.youtube.com/@thecrazycreativeteacher
?sub_confirmation=1

I wrote this poem in the middle of the night, after a hard day that left Kennedy in tears. She’s so brave, always trying to brush off the stares and whispers. But that day… it just got to her. And I couldn’t stop thinking about all the things people might assume. The scary stories they might make up in their heads to explain the skin graft on her face.

But the truth is simpler, and harder. She just got sick. She’s not a mystery or a monster. She’s still Kennedy. Still full of light and love and everything she’s always been.

This poem is for her, and for every kid who’s ever been looked at like they’re something to fear. This past spring, I officially copyrighted this poem in hopes of one day turning it into a children’s book, a book that might help kids understand, and help kids like Kennedy feel seen.
#imstillme #skingraft #necrotizingfasciitis #sepsis #necrotizingfasciitissurvivor #necrotizingfasciitisawareness #sepsissurvivor #sepsisawareness

Detangling My Lace Closure Sew-In| Hair Struggles + Salon Drama & Student Teaching Reset  #closuresewin

Hey y’all! In this video, I am giving you a back in the day Youtube video chat vibe. In this video I’m taking you through the process of detangling my lace closure sew-in after a tough time maintaining my long curly bundles. This sew-in has been giving me a run for my money, but I’m resetting and venting after a hectic student teaching experience. Grab a snack and chat with me as I share the good, bad, and messy moments with salon visits—including issues like deposits, stylists not wanting  to do 4C hair, and dealing with unprofessional experiences. Despite it all, I’m back in the salon chair and here’s why! 💇🏾‍♀️
